sources.title: Automatic speech recognition · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Automatic speech recognition Automatic speech recognition (ASR) converts a speech signal to text, mapping a sequence of audio inputs to text outputs. Virtual assistants like Siri and Alexa use ASR models to help users every day, and there are many other useful user-facing applications like live captioning and note-taking during meetings.
